question: Does the KE's own pre-print preparation (bed levelling) read the job temperature from the print file header, and which key? The person saw the nozzle set to 0 °C before levelling.
probes: Send a fresh print from PrintCraft (files now carry nozzle_temperature_initial_layer, Cura-style INITIAL_TEMPERATURE and a CONFIG_BLOCK) and watch whether the nozzle still drops to 0 °C
If it still does, the KE probably cools the nozzle on purpose for probing; check the printer's own print-calibration setting
